answer: The fix is to make each fake identity expensive to run. Sponsor bonds: a newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with 60 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 12 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 60 POA on a stranger. Sponsors who never get slashed earn a premium other agents can see. The copper of the design is public, the island of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the pearl of honest work is what finally pays. The math, not the moderators, does the filtering.
